links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient education responses (six readability indices) across models
links.effect: All six readability metrics differed significantly among models; Doubao produced more linguistically complex responses. Excessive complexity may limit suitability for public-facing education. PEMAT understandability did not differ (P = 0.063).
links.quote: All six readability metrics differed significantly among models, with Doubao generally producing more linguistically complex responses.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, readability, and reliability of patient education information generated by three general LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Doubao) for carotid-cavernous fistula, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
